summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K with its Q1 FY2026 consolidated financial results for the three months ended June 30, 2026. The report details quarterly performance, including an 8% sales increase to ¥2,837.8 billion and 40% operating income growth, and references the prior partial spin-off of Sony Financial Group Inc. It also discloses impacts from the 2026 Kumamoto earthquake on semiconductor facilities. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, activist activity, or other event requiring special-situations classification is present; this is a routine earnings announcement.
